name: State Bank of India
line: India's largest bank, owned mainly by the Government of India

brief.t: India's largest bank: about 53 crore customers, 23,265 branches and 64,245 ATMs (March 2026).
Led by Chairman C S Setty, its 27th Chairman, since 28 August 2024, with four Managing Directors.
Record FY 2025-26 net profit of ₹80,032 crore, the highest of any Indian bank.
Q2 FY27 profit rose 14.3% to ₹23,038 crore; Gross NPA fell to 1.39%, the lowest in over two decades.
Strongly digital: its YONO app has over 10 crore registered users.

timeline.t: Roots in the Bank of Calcutta, later the Imperial Bank of India.
Imperial Bank nationalised and renamed State Bank of India.
Associate banks and Bharatiya Mahila Bank merged into SBI.
C S Setty took charge as the 27th Chairman.

model.how: SBI earns mainly from the gap between interest on its huge loan book and interest paid to depositors. It also earns fees and runs subsidiaries in cards, insurance and mutual funds, and handles large amounts of government business.
flow: Bank lends to people, farmers, businesses, government

industry.regulator: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and Government of India (as main owner)
points: SBI's Chairman and MDs are appointed by the Government, usually from its own senior MDs.
As a public sector bank, SBI also carries out government schemes such as Jan Dhan accounts.
It competes with private banks like HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank on deposits and loans.

points.t: Gross advances ₹52.08 lakh cr (+17.8%); deposits ₹62.78 lakh cr (+12.3%).

numbers.say: SBI is India's most profitable bank, earning ₹80,032 crore in FY26, and serves about 53 crore customers.

rivals.note: SBI earned the highest profit of any Indian bank in FY26.

network.local: With branches in almost every town and village, SBI is a major employer across Punjab and North India, and often posts new officers to rural and semi-urban branches.

employer.note: SBI is one of India's largest employers and recruits officers mainly through its Probationary Officer (PO) exams, plus specialist and campus hiring.

csr.t: SBI spent ₹709 crore on CSR in FY 2025-26, reaching more than 58 lakh beneficiaries, and runs 164 rural self-employment training institutes (RSETIs).

frameworks.note: Framework views are analysis built from the verified facts on this page, not company statements.

glossary.Net profit: What is left after all costs, provisions and taxes. The bank's final earnings.
glossary.Net Interest Income: Interest earned on loans minus interest paid on deposits. A bank's main earning.
glossary.Net interest margin: Net Interest Income as a % of the bank's interest-earning assets. Shows how profitable lending is.
glossary.Gross NPA: Non-Performing Asset: a loan not repaid for 90+ days. Gross NPA is the % of all loans that have gone bad.
glossary.Net NPA: Bad loans after subtracting the money already set aside (provisions) for them. Lower is better.
glossary.CASA ratio: Share of deposits in Current and Savings accounts. These pay little interest, so a higher CASA means cheaper funds.
glossary.Capital adequacy ratio: The bank's own capital compared with the risk in its loans. RBI requires a minimum; higher means safer.
glossary.Provisions: Money set aside from profit to cover loans that may not be repaid.
glossary.Deposits: Money customers keep with the bank in savings, current and fixed deposit accounts.
glossary.Advances: Loans given by the bank to customers and businesses.
glossary.Dividend: Part of the profit paid to shareholders, per share.
glossary.Treasury gains: Profit from buying and selling bonds and other investments. It can swing a lot each quarter.
glossary.Attrition: The % of employees who leave in a year. Also called employee turnover.
glossary.RBI: Reserve Bank of India, which regulates all banks in India.
glossary.KYC: Know Your Customer: checking a customer's identity before opening an account.
glossary.MSME: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: small businesses that banks lend to.
glossary.Cross-sell: Selling an extra product (like a credit card) to an existing customer.
glossary.Public sector bank: A bank where the Government of India owns the majority of shares.
glossary.BRSR: Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report: an official yearly report on people, environment and governance that big listed companies must publish.

skills: Basics of RBI rules and Basel III
Finance.tip: Know Gross vs Net NPA, why CASA lowers a bank's cost of funds, and the bank's latest profit.

Marketing.tip: Think about reaching young and semi-urban customers through mobile and branch campaigns.

HR.tip: Banks hire thousands every year. Ideas to reduce early attrition and train people for digital work will impress.

Sales.tip: Expect role-play: 'Sell me a savings account' or 'Convince a shopkeeper to open a current account.'

Operations.tip: Show you understand KYC, turnaround time and how automation reduces errors.

interview.steps_label: SBI hires officers mainly through its Probationary Officer (PO) exam (prelims, mains, interview). Campus and specialist hiring varies, so confirm with your placement cell.

steps.d: Reasoning, data analysis, economy and banking awareness, English

Finance.q: How did SBI earn a record profit in FY26?
Finance.a: Strong loan growth, better asset quality and lower provisions lifted FY26 profit to ₹80,032 cr.

Finance.q: What is the provision coverage ratio?
Finance.a: The share of bad loans already covered by money set aside. Higher means safer.

Marketing.q: Only a part of SBI's customers use YONO. How would you increase it?
Marketing.a: Branch-assisted onboarding, regional-language campaigns, cashback on first UPI use, and simple tutorials for first-time users.

HR.q: SBI hired over 25,000 people in FY26. What challenges does that create?
HR.a: Training at scale, posting people to rural branches, and keeping young officers motivated.

Sales.q: How would you sell a home loan in a small town?
Sales.a: Use SBI's trust and wide reach, explain EMIs simply, and tie up with local builders.

Operations.q: How can SBI serve 53 crore customers efficiently?
Operations.a: More digital self-service, business correspondents in villages, and automation of routine tasks.

Other.q: What do you know about SBI?
Other.a: India's largest bank: ₹80,032 cr profit in FY26, 23,265 branches, about 53 crore customers, led by Chairman C S Setty.

gd.against: SBI earned record profits and serves financial inclusion goals.

avoid: Don't call SBI a private bank; it is a public sector bank, majority-owned by the government.
Don't confuse SBI with SBI Life, SBI Cards or SBI Mutual Fund; they are group companies.
